title: SWF (Shockwave Flash) signature
summary: An SWF file begins with 'FWS' (uncompressed, 0x46 0x57 0x53), 'CWS' (zlib-compressed, 0x43 0x57 0x53), or 'ZWS' (LZMA-compressed, 0x5A 0x57 0x53) followed by a 1-byte version and 4-byte file length.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: SWF is a binary format for vector graphics, animation, and ActionScript.
